version_policy: Each native receipt, SDK project/export, Go source/public module, command package, provider runtime and delivery set retains its own identity. No umbrella version or beta tag is inferred.

content_contracts.complete_native_receipt_v2: Install the complete selected CMake recipe: runtime entrypoints and libraries, exported SDK headers/archive/CMake config where declared, schemas/templates/owner docs/notices and strict receipt. QXCTL-REPRODUCIBLE.scope: Two isolated exact-source builds; retain identity and equality evidence, then qualify final delivery bytes separately.

GO-IDENTITIES.scope: Builds all six non-qxctl production commands with exact Go 1.26.5 and current catalog identities; one isolated build each, reproducibility not assessed.

SWIFT-PRODUCTION-BUNDLE.scope: Complete app bundle, codesign, real notary submission, staple/validate before existing installer seals receipt. Manual approval/execution only; no credential operation.

CLOUDFLARE-INTEL.scope: Exact source/native/Go closures plus separately prepared vendor bundle and protected Access transport closures; owner-admitted runtime versions unchanged.

DELIVERY-SET.scope: Preserve independently versioned units and bind actual archive, manifest, source/notices and trust records in reviewed delivery index; no complete index yet.

SOURCE-MATERIAL.scope: Derive exact committed first-party source with build/install material; add approved dependency source/provenance as required; publisher reviews completeness before delivery.

Exact C0 bundle admission and protected carrier/SSH/proxy receipt+manifest+qualification file closure, root-owned ancestry and explicitly authorized host policy; ordinary user connections.

open_inputs.required_input: Approve exact shipped component/capability selection, including the proposed core sets and separately selectable closures; resolve retained promises explicitly.
Approve the four declared core profiles and select the exact supplemental macOS Intel OS/deployment/host profile; platform declaration is not qualification.
Approve each independent package identity and the delivery-set identity; current source versions are proposals, not public beta tags.
Select shipped versus caller-supplied DuckDB/PDFium/curl/TLS/vendor/plugin runtime material and bind each promised operation to that choice.
Resolve missing-implementation versus retained-promise conflicts without adding frozen features or silently removing promised capabilities.
Approve exact Go/Swift delivery/install wrappers and complete multi-artifact index; native candidate tooling is not a prequalified universal installer.
Approve source/build/install material delivery and private/vendor material exclusions after corresponding-source review.
Assign build/packaging owners and provide approved native hosts, exact toolchains, dependency inputs and manual execution approval.
Choose actual candidate and public retrieval destinations, immutable identity policy, withdrawal channel and rollback artifacts.
Provide approved publisher SSH signer identity, public key fingerprint, allowed_signers policy and independent distribution/revocation channel; keep private key outside dossier.
Approve applicable Apple Developer ID/team/bundle/code requirement/entitlements/provisioning/notarization inputs before any signing or notary submission.
Publisher reviews exact selected vendor/runtime origin, notice closure and redistribution authorization, including any proprietary SDK.
Publisher reviews matching corresponding source, modifications and required build/install material against actual candidate contents and delivery method.
Resolve every shipped and system loader dependency, ABI/platform floor, TLS backend, package/file identity and applicable notice/source material.
Assign named package/trust reviewer, release approver and rollback/security response owner; record decisions against exact candidate digests.

artifact_observation_policy: Actual runtime/file/archive hashes, inventories, URLs, signer decisions and successful qualification stay null/empty until observed. Existing source-pinned vendor expectations remain in cited source contracts and are not candidate observations.

core_selection_derivation.rule: Native roots in groups whose proposed_selection.state begins proposed_core, plus recursive dependency_paths_in_build_order; preserve full receipts. Core Go roots except separately selectable protected profile administrator.
core_selection_derivation.operation_boundary: Dependency bytes do not select all optional operations; omissions require explicit retained-promise decision.

external_dependency_reference_semantics: Per-native external_dependency_refs preserve authoritative map direct_consumers/consumers and declared version/selection without choosing a new runtime. Inherit them recursively through dependency_recipe_ids. Dependencies without per-consumer enumeration and actual transitive/static/OS linkage still require final-artifact review. runtime_inputs are non-exhaustive reminders; no actual candidate runtime hashes are supplied.
